title: Income Tax & FEMA Guidelines for NRI Gifts: Relative Gifts Tax-Free; Non-Relative Exemption ₹50,000
summary: Clarifies tax-free gift rules under Income Tax Act 2025 and FEMA remittance limits.

blocks.content: Clarifies tax-free gift rules under Income Tax Act 2025 and FEMA remittance limits.

items: Tax Exemption: Gifts from specified relatives 100% tax-free; non-relative gifts taxable if aggregate exceeds ₹50,000 in a FY.
Immovable Property: NRIs/OCIs can receive residential/commercial property as gift; agricultural land, plantations, and farmhouses strictly restricted.
